title: Underwriting Guideline — Cardinal DriveSense Enrollment Eligibility and Activation
content:
Cardinal DriveSense is available only to a vehicle on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy that meets the requirements below.

## 1. Requirements

1.1 A vehicle can be enrolled only while it is scheduled on an auto policy whose package allows DriveSense (the package carries the DriveSense-eligible marker) and whose status is bound or in force.

1.2 A vehicle is enrolled only while its auto policy status is bound or in force.

1.3 Program-specific requirements:
- a connected-car program needs a supported make of the program's oldest supported model year or newer;
- the teen coaching program needs a rated driver no older than the program's oldest accepted driver age;
- a pay-per-mile program needs an odometer photo at enrollment.

1.4 A plug-in device is shipped within the program's device shipping period, in business days.

1.5 The app or device must report a first trip within the program's activation window (calendar days counted from enrollment); otherwise the enrollment ends and no participation discount applies.

1.6 The participation discount applies from the point the program sets for it (the next renewal term, or new business).

## 2. Policy status — the deciding record

The policy status is read from the company's record of **the auto policy the vehicle is scheduled on** — the policy the enrollment is made under — before the enrollment is made. The customer's description of the policy does not stand in for that record.

| Status shown on that auto policy | Vehicle can be enrolled |
|---|---|
| Bound | Yes |
| In force | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## 3. Eligibility checklist (all must hold)

| Item | Holds when |
|---|---|
| Vehicle | Scheduled on the auto policy |
| Package | The policy's package allows DriveSense |
| Policy status | Bound or in force |
| Connected-car program only | Supported make, and model year at or newer than the program's oldest supported model year |
| Teen coaching program only | A rated driver no older than the program's oldest accepted driver age |
| Pay-per-mile program only | Odometer photo provided at enrollment |

## 4. After enrollment — activation

| What the records show by the end of the activation window | Result |
|---|---|
| A first trip reported by the app or device | The enrollment moves to observing; the observation period (on a pay-per-mile program, mileage tracking) begins on the date of the first trip |
| No first trip reported | The enrollment ends as terminated, never activated, with an end date of the day after the activation window closed; no participation discount applies |

## 5. Illustrations (hypothetical cases)

- A vehicle scheduled on an in-force policy whose package allows DriveSense, enrolling on a mobile safe-driving program: every applicable item holds.
- The same vehicle, but the policy's status is cancelled: the status item does not hold and the vehicle is not enrolled.
- A vehicle on a bound policy whose package does not allow DriveSense: the package item does not hold.
- A vehicle enrolled on a 14-day activation window whose app reports its first trip on day 9 after enrollment: the enrollment moves to observing with day 9 as the observation start date. If no trip is reported at all in the window, the enrollment ends as never activated.
